latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Product Page Copywriter.

- Converts product briefs and market context into structured product page copy packs.
- Generates title candidates, hero benefits, detail-module structure, FAQ/closing copy, and compliance notes in markdown format.
- Built for teams needing multi-version, conversion-oriented copy before design or compliance review.
- Does not connect to live CMS, feeds, or compliance tools; relies on provided briefs and constraints.
- Enables preparation of copy suitable for various platforms and tones with clear separation of user benefits and features.
